Kerteminde is a Danish municipality evaluated in national healthcare quality assessments for the treatment of atrial fibrillation. In the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), Kerteminde is one of 98 municipalities analyzed for clinical quality indicators [^src1]. Specifically, the municipality's data regarding stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. The available evidence for Kerteminde is thin, limited to a single statistical entry on page 94 of the report that reflects its localized, heavily redacted or suppressed metrics for this specific quality indicator [^src1].
